name: Russia–NATO
value: Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec
summary: Estonia says Russia's GRU ordered a foiled arson attack on a drone maker on 14 Nov and will close its Russian border
state: Estonia's security service said an attempted explosion and arson at drone maker Threod Systems near Tallinn at 03:06 on 14 Nov was ordered by Russia's GRU military intelligence; suspects were detained (Kyiv Post). On 15 Nov Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said all road crossings with Russia would close from 1 Dec (Euromaidan Press). This follows drone alerts across the Baltic states on 10–11 Nov. No Article 4 request or attack on NATO territory was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Follow national government advice if travelling near NATO's eastern border; Estonia's road crossings to Russia close from 1 Dec.
rubric_hit: Sabotage plot attributed to Russia on NATO territory = Watch

sources.title: Kyiv Post — Estonia foils GRU-ordered sabotage attack on drone maker Threod Systems

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
